{"notes": "Visit 1, left at 1:45. Only what I saw and heard; I don't know who placed which domino.

Picture: one unbroken chain, all dark/connected, running from START (~28,4) in an S-curve to about x=8.5. No gaps or pale pieces. I see no separate second or bottom line, so it may not have started.

Jack: Announced the top line is going down and thanked Omar and Hana. Clear, positive communication. I didn't see him place anything, but the connected chain fits with the top line being his. Leadership/collaboration look good so far; execution is unverified.

Hana: Said she's staying on supply and that the bin is well stocked. Reliable, supportive role. Impact is indirect and I can't verify the bin. Also repeated that the bottom line is Omar's.

Omar: Per Jack and Hana, he took the bottom line at 1:15. At 1:30 he said he was back, handed the bottom line to Sofia ('looks like you've got it') and moved to checking the top line for breaks. The handoff was assumed rather than confirmed, and I see no bottom line in the picture. He's proactive about quality checks, but the top chain currently shows no breaks, so the patrol may be low value. Watch whether he drops ownership.

Sofia: Said nothing during my visit. I didn't see her do anything. Omar assumed she has the bottom line, but she never confirmed. Can't rate her yet; this is the key thing to check on visit 2. Silence isn't evidence of poor work.

Team risk: Jack and Hana think Omar owns the bottom line, Omar thinks Sofia does, and Sofia hasn't spoken. Nobody may actually own it. Follow up next visit."}
